newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA AVERAGE NET WAGE 8.5 PCT DOWN IN JANUARY.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA AVERAGE NET WAGE 8.5 PCT DOWN IN JANUARY.

text.p: The average net wage in Romania dropped by 8.5 percent in January from the previous month, but rose 54.7 percent year on year, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Friday.
A CNS report showed a January average net wage of 396,892 lei.
"The drop in wages combined with rising inflation led to a decline in purchasing power last month," CNS president Pavel Wagner said.
Purchasing power fell by 19.5 percent in January from December and was 12.3 percent down on January 1996. It was 60.1 percent of the 1990 level.
Inflation last month was 13.7 percent, up from 10.3 percent last December.

The report showed employees in the financial sector had had the highest net wage of 788,783 lei on average in January, with workers in hotels and restaurants sector paid the lowest at 284,452 lei. Romania employed some 5.51 million people at end-January, around 126,000 less than in December 1996.
